content.problemStatement: Print **"Learn Coding on SEED-IT"** to the console.
content.outputFormat: Print the string "Learn Coding on SEED-IT" exactly.

sampleTestCases.explanation: The program prints the required phrase.
No input is needed; the output is always the same.
Repeated test to confirm consistent output.

solution.approach: The task is trivial: there is no input, and the program must output the fixed phrase "Learn Coding on SEED-IT". The solution simply writes this constant string to standard output. No computation, loops, or conditionals are needed.

code.Python3:
import sys
sys.stdout.write("Learn Coding on SEED-IT\n")
code.JavaScript:
const fs = require('fs');
console.log('Learn Coding on SEED-IT');
